scripts.build: pnpm --filter @codexphone/shared build && pnpm --filter @codexphone/host build && pnpm --filter @codexphone/web build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @codexphone/shared build && pnpm --filter @codexphone/shared typecheck && pnpm --filter @codexphone/host typecheck && pnpm --filter @codexphone/web typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @codexphone/shared build && pnpm --filter @codexphone/host build && node --experimental-strip-types --test tests/core.test.mjs tests/operations.test.mjs tests/queue.test.mjs tests/accounts.test.mjs
scripts.test:smoke: pnpm --filter @codexphone/shared build && pnpm --filter @codexphone/host build && node tests/smoke.mjs
scripts.test:shared: pnpm --filter @codexphone/shared build && pnpm --filter @codexphone/host build && node scripts/test-shared-server.mjs
scripts.test:sync: pnpm --filter @codexphone/shared build && pnpm --filter @codexphone/host build && node tests/shared-flow.mjs && node tests/shared-host-flow.mjs && node tests/shared-adapter-flow.mjs && node tests/shared-adapter-lifecycle.mjs
scripts.test:launcher: pnpm --filter @codexphone/shared build && pnpm --filter @codexphone/host build && node tests/shared-launcher-flow.mjs
